mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tours WHERE title = BTRIM(#{title})) AS slug_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tours WHERE slug = BTRIM(#{slug})) AS name_exists

INSERT INTO public.tours ( tour_types_id, organizers_id, images_id, title, slug, video_link, md_desc, highlights, group_size, group_info, faq, transports, cancel_ins, start_ins, finish_ins, start_at, finish_at, last_sell_at, image_ids ) VALUES ( #{tourTypesId}, #{organizersId}, #{imagesId}, BTRIM(#{title}), BTRIM(#{slug}), #{videoLink}, #{mdDesc}, #{highlights}, #{groupSize}, #{groupInfo}, #{faq}, #{transports}, #{cancelIns}, #{startIns}, #{finishIns}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startAt}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI'), TO_TIMESTAMP(#{finishAt}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI'), TO_TIMESTAMP(#{lastSellAt}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI'), #{imageIdsStr} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tours SET tour_types_id = #{tourTypesId}, organizers_id = #{organizersId}, images_id = #{imagesId}, title = BTRIM(#{title}), slug = BTRIM(#{slug}), video_link = #{videoLink}, md_desc = #{mdDesc}, highlights = #{highlights}, group_size = #{groupSize}, group_info = #{groupInfo}, faq = #{faq}, transports = #{transports}, cancel_ins = #{cancelIns}, start_ins = #{startIns}, finish_ins = #{finishIns}, start_at = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startAt}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI'), finish_at = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{finishAt}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI'), last_sell_at = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{lastSellAt}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI'), image_ids = #{imageIdsStr} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.* , tt.name AS tour_type_name, o.name AS organizer_name, o.verification AS organizer_verification, string_agg(DISTINCT p.name, ',') AS place_names, string_agg(distinct d.name, ',') AS district_names , string_agg(distinct pkg.price::text , ',') AS package_prices FROM public.tours t JOIN public.organizers o ON t.organizers_id = o.id JOIN public.tour_types tt ON t.tour_types_id = tt.id JOIN public.tour_logs tl ON tl.tours_id = t.id JOIN public.tour_logs_places tlp ON tlp.tour_logs_id = tl.id JOIN public.places p ON tlp.places_id = p.id JOIN public.districts d ON p.districts_id = d.id JOIN public.packages pkg ON pkg.tours_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, tt.id , o.id ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT * FROM public.tour_logs WHERE tours_id = #{id} ORDER BY DATE ASC
